Japan PM to Visit India for Talks on Defense, Trade, Semiconductors

Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is scheduled to visit India for discussions with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Key areas of focus for the bilateral talks will include defense cooperation, trade, and collaboration on semiconductor manufacturing. The visit occurs amidst ongoing geopolitical tensions, particularly concerning China.
